patterns: Educational Mashups: Combining core preschool learning (ABCs, Numbers, Phonics) with engaging themes like vehicles, food, or movement.
Curiosity & Problem-Solving Hooks: Catchy titles centered around a mystery, mild visual problem, or daily habit (e.g., unexpected spots on teeth, mysterious nature facts, lost items).
Rhyming Word Pairings: Short-form videos focused on quick, rhythm-driven phonics (e.g., One-Sun, Low-Slow) optimized for quick retention.
Emotional Payoff & Gentle Morals: Narrative stories that start with a simple conflict or emotional tone (sadness, fear of dark/rain) and resolve into warmth, family togetherness, or honesty.
Bite-Sized Action & Movement: Fast-paced vertical shorts encouraging physical toddler milestones (walking, jumping, brushing teeth).
